summary: Xiao-I Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on an update in patent litigation between its variable interest entity and Apple Inc. The Shanghai High People's Court issued first-instance judgments dismissing Xiao-I's infringement claims and ruling that certain iPhone models with Siri do not infringe the patent. The company intends to appeal to the Supreme People's Court. No deal terms or special-situation transaction are present; this is a routine legal-proceeding update.
